evidence_state: implementation specified before any phase C raw-data computation
exact_coordinate: a_k=epsilon_k/(Et_k+Ef_k); w_k=(Et_k+Ef_k)/sum_j(Et_j+Ef_j); fixed support, no shell exclusion

inferred_rate_domain.refinement: 0.15<=a_k<=0.85 for every shell in the fixed partition at a retained time; exclude whole time rows, never individual shells
inferred_rate_domain.reason: avoid endpoint-sensitive inferred rates; preserve historical bracket while correcting changing-domain issue
inferred_rate_domain.status: descriptive sensitivity restriction, not a physical pass threshold

derivatives.primary: unsmoothed centered secant on equal-cadence three-point support; t<=12
derivatives.sensitivity: unsmoothed centered secant with span two on equal-cadence five-point support; t<=12
derivatives.unavailable: endpoints and cadence transitions; no interpolation inserted for derivative observations

arithmetic_tolerance.does_not_apply_to: finite-difference product-rule residual, physical closure error, or scientific significance

bound.object: auxiliary piecewise-linear interpolation of sampled aggregate A
bound.interval: contiguous 0<=A<=1 consecutive 0.1-TU intervals through t<=12; gaps and later sparse intervals excluded
bound.reference: independent archived band energy lambda0 after inherited burn-in; initialized at first point of each eligible interval without retrospective half-height shift
bound.quadrature: split each quadratic defect at real interior roots; Gauss-Legendre 16 and 32 orders
bound.error_reporting: difference between quadrature orders, propagated by the same exponential recurrence; convergence estimate only, not a certified error enclosure

continuous_budget_caveat: Primary k10..20 has no directly forced modes. In directly white-noise-forced bands a continuous normalized quotient may need an Ito correction; phase C does not extrapolate its classical derivative identity there.
execution_authority: User approved existing-data phases A-C; root will run physical reconstruction pilot before phase C execution.

independent_common_reference.definition: q_ref,k=D_t a_k-lambda_b*a_k*(1-a_k), using independently archived tangent band lambda_b as explicitly prescribed common local reference
independent_common_reference.status: available sampled residual against independently prescribed reference; not a measured heterogeneous shell-clock decomposition
independent_common_reference.report: signed terms, sumabs/cancellation with and without temporal product residual, per-shell q_ref distributions and weighted RMS; no fit or new integration
independent_common_reference.interpretation_limit: reference inadequacy quantified subject to finite-difference and storage precision, without physical attribution

operator_common_reference.preexecution_status: added before any phase-C raw calculation or output inspection; A/B pilot may run independently
operator_common_reference.inputs: phase-A/B verified and hash-checked P_linear_shell, P_tl_nonlinear_shell, P_pure_error_shell, Sdot_deterministic_shell on saved primary-band fields
operator_common_reference.coordinate: same exact fixed-shell epsilon/S and S weights as FD analysis
operator_common_reference.windows: primary descriptive summaries at t<=12; all125-snapshot record summaries separate; operator-minus-FD comparisons only common dense derivative support
operator_common_reference.normalizer: primary k10..20 excludes directly forced modes; deterministic modal Sdot is the applicable continuous-operator tendency there
operator_common_reference.checks: finite-sum reconstruction with same dimensionally scaled arithmetic tolerance; operator-vs-FD mismatch is reported as sampling sensitivity, not required to be machinezero
operator_common_reference.interpretation: residual to independently prescribed common tangent-band rate, not fitted/inferred shell clocks or physical-cause attribution; no continuous-time bound without intersnapshot envelope
